about: What NPCs fight with beyond the levels in their cache types. Speeds, max hits, attack styles, bonuses and respawn times are the OSRS Wiki infoboxes' (read 2026-10-26), cross-checked with the Wiki's DPS calculator data (weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc monsters.json). Animations are gameval names: attack and death are the NPC's own by name; which of an NPC's block or def animations it defends with is guessed.

npcs.source: OSRS Wiki, Dark wizard (level 7: ids 512, 5086, 5087): speed 4, max hit 2, magic, Water Strike and Confuse, the bonuses and respawn 50. Aggressive (the Wiki's infobox). Spotanims are the spells' own (waterstrike_* 93 to 95, confuse_* 102 to 104), Confuse lowering Attack 5% (Wiki, Confuse). Guessed: the two spells as likely as each other, the 10-tile range (a spell's), and the unarmed block
OSRS Wiki, Man (ids 3106 to 3109 share the infobox; Al Kharid's man, 3261, is a version of the same page and shares it too, though the DPS calculator gives it 0 defence bonuses)

OSRS Wiki, Al Kharid warrior and the DPS calculator's 3292, read 2026-10-30; the scimitar it holds slashes as a sword does (human_sword_slash; its block guessed). Warriors that join in when one is attacked wait for NPC aggression (the Varrock piece)

OSRS Wiki, Guard (Varrock 1 to 7, the 2022 guards 11911 to 11917) and the DPS calculator's 11911, 11914 and 11917, read 2026-10-30. Their attack animation is INFERRED from the longsword they hold: human_sword_slash (390), the swing a player with a longsword makes; not yet watched on live. human_blunt_pound, guessed before from the crush style, raised the sword straight over the guard's head (Sam's screenshot at the palace fountain, 2026-11-01). Their block is INFERRED: all seven carry a kiteshield (the Wiki's pictures of Varrock 1 to 7; the cache types wear a longsword, model 518, and a shield), and a human holding a shield blocks with human_shield_defence (1156), as a player holding a shield does on live (from memory, not checked against a recording). human_blunt_block, guessed before, swung the shield up over the guard's head (Sam's screenshot, 2026-11-01)
